# Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026: permitting reform tracker

> Section index, plain-language summaries, verbatim quotes with page and line cites, and a comparison with the SPEED Act and the Energy Permitting Reform Act of 2024. Bill text released 2026-09-30; 417 pages, 71 sections. Data as of 2026-10-05.

- Site: https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/
- Bill PDF (official): https://www.epw.senate.gov/public/_cache/files/5/c/5c5f5935-b224-48e7-abea-e60c30e7a4cf/7935BF3C85967B6F56F6F4858FD3221B7E0AEB02D04BE391CAFBD1B884CE3DC5.bipartisan-american-affordability-and-jobs-act-text.pdf
- Source data: https://github.com/pranava0x0/permittingreform

## Reading and retrieval

Independent tracker. BAAJA is the September 30, 2026 draft, not enacted law. Summaries are AI-assisted. Verify legal claims against the official PDF and compare the specified versions, not later amendments.
PDF citations use printed bill pages and lines. A matching quote proves occurrence; it does not validate nearby interpretations. Source positions describe the cited item, not every position held by its author.
- [No-JavaScript section index](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/reading.html)
- [Full text and analysis](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/llms-full.txt): all sections, comparisons, timeline, people and media with citations.
- [Tracker JSON](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/data/core.json): the same data the browser renders, including check coverage.
- [Bill paragraph JSON](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/data/bill.json): section number to [printed page, line, indent level, text] arrays.
- [Timeline, people and media JSON](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/data/news.json): dated events, positions and coverage, each with its sources.
- [Outside readings JSON](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/data/takes.json): what named industry groups, advocates, lawyers and analysts say sections would do, each with its verbatim quote, source link and the bill passage it concerns.
- Fetch sections/{number}.md for one section. Each file includes its summary with a page-and-line cite after every sentence, cited key points, quotes, outside readings of what the section would do (quoted from their sources), comparison notes and full statutory text.
- Browser search: #/bill/search/{URL-encoded query}; section: #/bill/sec/{number}; passage: #/bill/sec/{number}/{page}-{line}; cited range: #/bill/sec/{number}/{page}-{line}-{page}-{line}. Fragment routes require JavaScript; use the Markdown or JSON endpoints for HTTP retrieval.

## Check coverage

Saved AI review: 794 supported, 0 flagged, 18 unchecked of 812 statements; checked 2026-10-06; stale: false. Coverage excludes current-law comparison cells and some research paraphrases. Read data/core.json checks for link and quote results and their dates. A stale review does not verify the current wording.

## Research

- [Data center bills and Communities](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/llms-full.txt): BAAJA beside the Ratepayer Protection Act, GRID Savings Act, Power for the People Act, GRID Act and current policy; and who can comment, consult, plan or sue.
- [Timeline, people and media](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/llms-full.txt): dated records with source links and attributed positions.
- [Method and check status](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/#/method): browser view; equivalent checks are in data/core.json.
- [Subject comparisons](https://pranava0x0.github.io/permittingreform/#/compare): browser view; retrieve the compare object in data/core.json without JavaScript.
